description:
## Approved plan task C1

- **Functional scope/files:** decision/task records and adapter contract. Identity verification and endpoint ownership are approved in section 4.4; do not reopen a ZAQ bearer/proof-format decision. Resolve remaining domain/protocol decisions in section 11 before their affected implementation. In Build mode, first reconcile C1–D2 Beadwork descriptions with this plan; do not implement a ZAQ public widget endpoint.
- **Required contract additions:** widget ID equals channel config ID; routing channel is a selector validated by Engine, not an authority to choose any agent; allowed origins/domains, display name, stylesheet policy; optional prompt context; public response projection; sync/async behavior; initialization-created notification and history shape/bounds.
- **Package boundary:** ZAQ owns the shared structs. The external package must not gain a cyclic compile-time dependency on the host. Its ZAQ adapter/host integration constructs the same structs (or uses an injected host constructor); WebBridge must not accept two competing normalized payload families. Freeze how this is wired before handing off signatures.
- **Tests before implementation:** ZAQ conformance covers verified sender resolution, conflicting payload sender versus trusted sender, missing trusted context, foreign conversation/topic/capability, unknown/disabled widget, cross-widget identity/history isolation and malformed mode/version. The adapter's own suite must prove forged sender, absent/invalid/expired verification, origin denial and unauthorized subscription are rejected before ZAQ ingress; a fixture is not evidence that the real endpoint is secure.
- **Branches:** fresh/resumed conversation, missing/unresolvable/inactive sender, invalid config, optional prompt context and supported/unsupported synchronous modes. Adapter authentication and origin branches remain external acceptance requirements.
- **Mocking:** none for decisions; external widget conformance adapter will be used in C3/C4.
- **Documentation:** approved contract delta and changed issue scope (inbound edit excluded); update GitHub only when separately authorized.
- **Action reuse:** first assess `Conversations.list_canonical_messages/3` / TranscriptHistory, History strategy/Facts/Ingress and connector-scoped People resolution. PeopleConversations' bearer facade is not the widget identity boundary. Record the conversation-to-transcript binding and public permission resource, then reuse/extend/new only for missing C2 composition.
- **Done:** approved adapter trust model is reflected in tasks and conformance requirements; remaining conversation ownership and prompt-context authority choices are settled before affected implementation.

## Execution requirements
Branch: refactor/webbridge. Source: GitHub www-zaq-ai/zaq#830. Read AGENTS.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, and applicable service guides before implementation. Shared contracts, module responsibilities, reuse evidence, decisions and regression obligations are in parent zaq-pkd. Write specified immediate tests first; use real internal boundaries and mock only external edges. Preserve canonical-history authorization, config-scoped delivery and Engine admission/finalization. New/substantially rewritten feature E2E must wait for B3 human approval. Inbound message.edit is excluded; outbound streaming edits remain included.


## Sequencing
Blocked by zaq-pkd.8 (B4).
Blocks zaq-pkd.10 (C2).
Human BO approval: zaq-pkd.7. Persistent consolidated E2E/regression issue: zaq-pkd.8. Widget decision gate: zaq-pkd.9.

comments.text: User identity decision 2026-10-04: widget relays a user_id from the parent application where deployed; resolve this external identity through the People directory, treating web_widget as a Person channel, analogous to JidoChat adapter identification. This is not a choice of People bearer authentication. Before implementation, audit existing adapter identity resolution and config scoping; explicitly resolve how parent-app asserted user_id is authenticated/trusted so browser-forged identities cannot impersonate another Person. Remaining C1 decisions are still open.

Identity audit: Channels IdentityScope defaults non-attested platforms to connector:<config_id>; People.IdentityResolver validates provider/config and resolves external author through People.match_by_channel/3 and find_or_create_from_channel. Current IdentityResolver.resolve/2 treats every :web provider as BO (:bo_user), so widget identity must be distinguished explicitly rather than inheriting trusted BO identity. Canonical history requires persisted Person + trusted config/transcript scope and grants; directory lookup alone does not authenticate the asserted user_id. Proposed mapping: platform web_widget, authority connector:<widget config id>, identifier parent-app user_id. Pending human decision: signed parent-app assertion vs authenticated server relay (or specified verified alternative); absent/invalid assertion must not authenticate as the claimed Person.

Approved identity/endpoint decision synchronized into epic sections 1/3/4/11 and C1-C4/D1-D2 task descriptions, retaining execution requirements and dependency chain. External adapter verifies parent user_id and supplies trusted sender_id; host maps it to shared author_id, resolves connector-scoped web_widget People identity, and separately authorizes Engine operations. ZAQ imposes no bearer/proof format and owns no widget endpoint. Endpoint security acceptance belongs to actual external adapter, not fixture conformance. Current reader bounds verified: after_position >= 0, optional up_to_position >= cursor, default limit 50, max 100. Direct history uses explicit participant grants via ChannelHistoryResource and no membership synchronization. Remaining C1 choices to confirm before C2: private Person/widget/chat binding with fail-closed resume; prompt-context input/lifetime/projection; synchronous wait/timeout semantics. Proposed history wire preserves existing bounds. Proposed created notification stays in synchronous initialization response, not pre-subscription PubSub. No widget implementation started.

C1 domain decisions approved by user 2026-10-04: private chat per resolved Person/widget config with explicit conversation/transcript binding, Direct participant grants and fail-closed resume; server-configurable sync wait default 30s, one terminal response, timeout unknown outcome without cancellation/retry, history recovery. Prompt context is creation-only first ordinary user history message, no Agent execution/reply, visible authorized history, no reseeding on resume. User explicitly requires reusing existing seeding/persistence mechanism, not building a new subsystem. Existing reuse evidence: Engine :conversation/:add_message dispatch, Conversations.add_message/2; BO persist_welcome_message demonstrates command-free initialization persistence, canonical capture must be composed rather than duplicated. Reader bounds remain default 50/max 100 and existing position cursors. Initialization creation indication remains synchronous before subscription. Host construction hook creates ZAQ-owned structs from adapter-normalized facts/trusted sender without cyclic dependency; exact signatures follow implementation conformance. Updated approved plan, epic and dependent task descriptions; documented approved-but-unimplemented widget contract in docs/services/channels.md and removed a stale legacy-delivery paragraph. Docs-only validation: git diff --check passed, current/proposed labelling checked, no new links. No application tests required for this decision/documentation gate. Repository docs remain uncommitted; only B4 Git commit was authorized. All product/security decisions needed for C2 are now settled; audit actual shared binding/capture feasibility before implementation and escalate any missing prerequisite.
